Ultimate Vocal Remover (UVR)
https://github.com/Anjok07/ultimatevocalremovergui
Pinned source: 5517e0cf0d1acd16a1618eeedec596957523f9e1

Credit to UVR's developers, Anjok07 and the contributors listed in tools/uvr/README.md,
and to the Demucs and MDX-Net model authors. DJStem uses the UVR engine and the
UVR-MDX-NET Inst HQ 5 model; it does not use UVR's graphical application or branding.

UVR's README declares its code MIT-licensed and asks third-party application
developers using its models to credit UVR and its developers. That README and
the complete pinned engine source are included in tools/uvr/.

Model source: https://github.com/TRvlvr/model_repo/releases/tag/all_public_uvr_models
Demucs source: https://github.com/facebookresearch/demucs
